* Risk-Free Rate is the return on a risk-free asset

The CAPM has been widely used in finance to estimate the required return on an investment, to evaluate the performance of a portfolio, and to determine the cost of capital for a company. 5. Calculate the enterprise value: Add the present value of the cash flows and the terminal value to get the enterprise value of the company.
6. Calculate the equity value: Subtract the company's debt from the enterprise value to get the equity value.
